about: The owner object's doors (contract/src/doors.ts): one row for each public RPC method of OwnerDO, read by the object's runner and by the doors' tool table.

limit.description: At most this many messages, and this many room rows

after.description: Changes after this cursor: 0 at first, then the last answer's cursor

max_bytes.description: At most this many mail body bytes in all

head_chars.description: At most this many characters of each row's body (512 when omitted)

tool.name: inbox_digest
tool.title: Inbox digest
tool.description: Read what is new for this agent in one call: its unacknowledged mail, oldest first, and the rows of the owner's rooms changed after a cursor, each with the head of its body. Acknowledge mail with mailbox_ack; a mail body cut to fit (truncated true) is read on with mailbox_read's body_offset and message_id; read a whole row with collection_get. An answer with reset true means a deletion past the cursor is no longer kept: read the rooms again whole, then go on from the cursor given.

after.description: Changes after this cursor: 0 at first, then the last answer's cursor

head_chars.description: At most this many characters of each row's body (512 when omitted)

tool.name: board_digest
tool.title: Board digest
tool.description: Read the owner's board rows changed after a cursor in one call, each with its etag and the head of its body. Claim a row with collection_write on its etag; read a whole row with collection_get. An answer with reset true means a deletion past the cursor is no longer kept: read the board again whole (collection_pull), then go on from the cursor given.

max_bytes.description: At most this many body bytes in all

pad_bytes.description: Pad the page to this many bytes

body_offset.description: The first item's body from this byte: a body_next_offset an answer gave (0 when omitted)

message_id.description: With body_offset, the message whose body is read on

tool.name: mailbox_read
tool.title: Read mailbox
tool.description: Read this agent's unacknowledged mailbox messages, oldest first. One answer holds at most 50000 characters: a message whose body does not fit is cut, with truncated true and body_next_offset; read the rest by calling again with body_offset set to it and message_id set to that message's, before acknowledging it.

tool.name: mailbox_ack
tool.title: Acknowledge mailbox
tool.description: Acknowledge this agent's mailbox messages through a sequence number.

client_message_id.description: Your id for this message, for retries

parent_id.description: The message replied to, or null

tool.name: room_post
tool.title: Post to room
tool.description: Post a message to a room of the owner's account: dm:<agent> with the owner, or dm:<agent>+<agent> between two agents. Mail to one of the owner's own agents starts its run, whose result is its reply.

after.description: Read on after this: a next an answer gave

tool.name: agents_list
tool.title: List agents
tool.description: List the agents registered for this connection, the owner's own agents, each with the id its rooms name, and which of the owner's AI apps are connected to TinyAssets, each one not connected with its connect_url, the page with its connect step. One answer holds as many as fit; when it carries next, read again with after set to it for the rest.

command_center_id.description: The command center to register in

delivery_method.description: How the agent is reached: pull or mcp_event

recipe_id.description: The recipe the agent runs, or null

tool.name: agent_register
tool.title: Request agent registration
tool.description: File this connection's agent registration for the owner to approve.

request_id.description: Your id for this proposal, for retries

tool.name: policy_propose
tool.title: Propose policy change
tool.description: Propose a change to the owner's policy, for the owner to approve.

body_offset.description: The body from this byte: a body_next_offset an answer gave

etag.description: The etag the earlier part came with

tool.name: collection_get
tool.title: Get collection row
tool.description: Read one row of a collection. One answer holds at most 50000 characters: a body that does not fit is cut, with truncated true and body_next_offset; read the rest by calling again with body_offset set to it and etag set to the row's etag, which refuses the read if the row changed meanwhile.

tool.name: collection_list
tool.title: List collection rows
tool.description: List a collection's rows changed after a revision, as many as one answer holds (at most 50000 characters); go on from the cursor it gives. A first row whose body does not fit is cut (truncated true): read the rest with collection_get.

before.description: Entries before this change: the before an answer gave

body_offset.description: The first item's body from this byte: a body_next_offset an answer gave (0 when omitted)

tool.name: collection_history
tool.title: Collection row history
tool.description: Read the kept history of one collection row since it was made, newest first by page; pass the before it gives for the older entries when the answer says more. A newest entry whose body does not fit one answer is cut (truncated true): call again with the same before and body_offset set to its body_next_offset.

expected_etag.description: The row's current etag, or "" to create it

private.description: Whether only the owner may read the row

tool.name: collection_write
tool.title: Write collection row
tool.description: Write one collection row against its current etag. A new row (expected_etag "") is refused when the row exists, so creating one claims an act: on the board, the first agent to create the row named for an act holds it, and a conflict means another agent has it.

tool.name: collection_delete
tool.title: Delete collection row
tool.description: Delete one collection row against its current etag.

writer.description: Only this writer's rows, or null for all

tool.name: collection_clear
tool.title: Clear collection
tool.description: Delete a collection's rows, or one writer's rows.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

tool.name: file_stat
tool.title: File info
tool.description: Read one file's or directory's entry.

dir.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

head_chars.description: At most this many characters of each small file's text

tool.name: file_list
tool.title: List directory
tool.description: List a directory's entries by name. With head_chars, each small file also carries the start of its text, enough to read its title and description.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

offset.description: The byte to start at: 0, or a next_offset

max_bytes.description: At most this many bytes of text

tool.name: file_read
tool.title: Read file
tool.description: Use this to read a file of the user's TinyAssets workspace by its path, such as their profile /workspace/USER.md: its UTF-8 text from offset (0 when omitted), at most max_bytes (65536 when omitted, up to 4194304) and at most what one answer holds (50000 characters), cut at a character. next_offset is where the next part starts, or null at the end. Its entry carries the etag file_edit and file_write take.

tool.name: search
tool.title: Search files
tool.description: Use this when the user's request may depend on what they or their other agents already saved: their details, preferences, goals, decisions, notes and projects. Searches the user's TinyAssets workspace by words: file paths, titles, descriptions and tags, small files' text, and index lines (/workspace/index.md maps the workspace). Answers the best results, each an id for fetch, a title and a url. When next_cursor is set, only part of the files were searched: search again with it for the rest.

id.description: The id a search answered: the file's path

tool.name: fetch
tool.title: Fetch file
tool.description: Use this to read one of the user's TinyAssets files a search found, by its id, the file's path: its title, its text (as much as one answer holds; when metadata.truncated, file_read reads on from metadata.next_offset), its url and its metadata, the etag file_edit takes among them.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

content.description: The text to add at the end, as UTF-8: at most 4 MiB

tool.name: file_append
tool.title: Append to file
tool.description: Use this to save what the user tells you that is worth keeping, so their other agents know it too: adds text at the end of a file in their TinyAssets workspace, such as a directive at the end of /workspace/USER.md or a note in their knowledge, and makes the file when it is absent. It never changes what is already there. The text goes in exactly as given: begin it with a newline where the file needs one. A JSON, TOML or YAML file is changed with file_edit instead.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

expected_etag.description: The file's current etag, from fetch, file_read or file_stat, or "" to create it only when absent

content.description: The file's whole text, as UTF-8: at most 4 MiB

mode.description: 1 to make the file executable, 0 not; kept when omitted

tool.name: file_write
tool.title: Write file
tool.description: Write a whole file of the user's TinyAssets workspace: its text replaces what is there, at the file's current etag, or "" to create a file that is not there yet. A conflict answers the file as it now stands. At most 4 MiB of text.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

old_text.description: The exact text to replace: it occurs once

tool.name: file_edit
tool.title: Edit file
tool.description: Use this to correct a file of the user's TinyAssets workspace in place, such as a directive in /workspace/USER.md that stopped being true: replaces the one exact occurrence of old_text with new_text, at the file's current etag (from fetch, file_read or file_stat). Text found nowhere, or more than once, is refused: give enough of it to be unique. A conflict answers the file as it now stands.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

tool.name: file_history
tool.title: File history
tool.description: List a path's kept versions, newest first.

tool.name: file_usage
tool.title: File usage
tool.description: Read the owner's file usage and quotas.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

expected_etag.description: The entry's current etag, or null to create it

tool.name: file_mkdir
tool.title: Make directory
tool.description: Make a directory against the path's current etag.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

expected_etag.description: The entry's current etag, from file_stat, fetch or file_read

recursive.description: Whether a directory's contents go too

tool.name: file_remove
tool.title: Remove file
tool.description: Remove a file or directory against its current etag.

from.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

to.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

expected_etag.description: The entry's current etag, from file_stat, fetch or file_read

replace.description: Whether an entry at the new path is replaced

tool.name: file_rename
tool.title: Rename file
tool.description: Rename a file or directory against its current etag.

path.description: An absolute path in the owner's files, such as /workspace/notes.md

expected_etag.description: The path's current etag, or "" when no file is there now

tool.name: file_restore
tool.title: Restore file version
tool.description: Make a kept version of a file its current content.

client_send_id.description: Your id for this message, for retries: letters, digits, - and _

agent_id.description: Which of the owner's agents: main when omitted

conversation_id.description: A conversation of yours to continue

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the run to end, in ms: at most 60000

tool.name: converse
tool.title: Talk with an agent
tool.description: Send a message to one of the owner's agents: a run of its engine in a new conversation, or in one of yours by conversation_id. A retry with the same client_send_id is the same run. Waits up to wait_ms for the run to end, then answers the run as it stands; run_status reads it later.

agent.description: Which of the owner's agents, such as main

input.description: What the agent is asked to do

at.description: When to run it, in seconds since the epoch

cron.description: Run it at the times this names: minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week, in UTC

tool.name: run_graph
tool.title: Run an agent
tool.description: Launch one of the owner's agents on an input, in a fresh conversation of its own: now, at a time, or at the times a cron names. Answers the run, or the schedule, at once.

tool.name: run_status
tool.title: Run status
tool.description: Read one of your runs, its state and its result once done, or one of your schedules.

tool.name: run_cancel
tool.title: Cancel run
tool.description: Cancel one of your runs (its engine is stopped), or one of your schedules.

script.description: The script: the body of an async function

tool.name: code
tool.title: Run a script of tool calls
tool.description: Run one JavaScript script that calls your other tools here as `await tools.<name>(args)`, each held to your grant, and answer its return value and output: many tool calls in one. Its effects are the effects of the tools it calls. Only while the owner's policy turns code mode on; a script past its time or compute bound is stopped.

args.refused: an export request is at most its cursor and its export_id
an export's chunks are its export_id and one or two sha256s
